title: Comfort Club Missed-Visit Fee on Forfeited Tune-Ups
content:
**Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements — missed-visit fee.**

## Rule
On a tier whose missed visits are forfeited, a visit recorded as a no-show or a late-cancellation forfeit is charged a missed-visit fee on the agreement's dues ledger, billed to the month in which the fee is posted. The fee is worked out when the most recent forfeited visit on record is one that carries no fee.

A missed-appointment fee for a visit forfeited in a lapsed term is not posted until the agreement is back in active status with its reinstated term on record.

In the same terms: while the agreement is not back in active status with its reinstated term on record, a fee for a visit forfeited in the lapsed term is not posted.

The fee appears on the member's dues history as a missed-appointment fee charge, and the dues balance rises by the fee.

## System entry: `post_missed_visit_fee_325d3ccb`
Posting the fee is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks `post_missed_visit_fee_325d3ccb` and then calls it. One missed-appointment fee charge is added to the dues history for the billing month given.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the member's Comfort Club agreement, read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `billing_period` | Billing month the fee is charged to | YYYY-MM |
| `fee_amount` | Missed-appointment fee charged | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded to the cent by the caller |

### Return
The receipt carries `billing_entry_id` (reference number of the fee charge), `agreement_id`, `billing_period` (YYYY-MM), `fee_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `dues_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, signed: positive means the member owes) and `status`, always "posted".

### Illustration (hypothetical values)
A fee of 35.00 posted in March 2026 is billed to `billing_period` 2026-03; a dues balance of 0.00 becomes 35.00.
